label: Pathway Count per Ontology Term
description: Counts the pathways tagged with each ontology term. Pathways can be tagged with terms from the Pathway, Cell Line and Disease ontologies; wp:ontologyTag covers all of them, as well as the curation and community tags.
query:
PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?pwOntologyTerm (count(?pwOntologyTerm) as ?pathwayCount)
WHERE {
  ?pathwayRDF wp:ontologyTag ?pwOntologyTerm .
}
GROUP BY ?pwOntologyTerm
ORDER BY DESC(?pathwayCount)
